# Sudipto Kumar

> Personal portfolio of Sudipto Kumar, a BBA student specializing in Finance and Banking at Patuakhali Science and Technology University (PSTU), Bangladesh. He builds web projects, digital products, AI-assisted workflows and Telegram automation systems.

Canonical site: https://sudiptokumar.vercel.app/ (single-page portfolio; the Netlify copy redirects here).

Not to be confused with other people named Sudipto Kumar. This Sudipto Kumar studies Finance and Banking at PSTU, Patuakhali, Bangladesh.
